item.title: UCSF debuts new unit for neurosurgical patients
item.description: Service expansion: UCSF Benioff Children’s Hospital San Francisco in San Francisco, CA opened an eight-bed Children's Neuroscience Specialty Unit, expanding inpatient capacity for children with neurological and neurosurgical conditions. Published 2026-07-22; effective 2026-07-22.

item.title: UnitedHealthcare, ECU Health extend agreement until August
item.description: Temporary network-access extension: ECU Health hospitals in Greenville, NC will remain in network for some UnitedHealthcare plans through 2026-08-06 under a temporary extension. Published 2026-07-21; effective 2026-08-06.
